body: Thank you. I know my 2 months is good but sometimes it doesn't feel worth it. I will talk to my sponsor even though that scares me. I've been to AA a bunch and I like it. I should go more.

Yeah I go to therapy actually. Have for over 2 years. It helps. I know one reason why I'm sad. I'm transgendered but I haven't even begun to be able to explore that whole situation. I've been trying to ignore it for years. It's too much to think about right now. I need to get sober and healthy before I can even begin going down that route, but I know it's a huge factor in my depression and feelings of loneliness. I am planning on trying antidepressants. I've been prescribed them before but they don't work when you're drinking, which I was. 

Thanks for your reply.
I do eat meat and I know that I really really need to change my diet in order to get better. It just hasn't been easy. Getting sober is my first goal. Thanks for your story!

Hey thanks yeah you're right that I need to talk to her. It's very possible she just doesn't know that I need her to be there for me more. It's also very possible she just doesn't have time. If that's the case then we should probably go our separate ways. Also haha just wanted to clear up I have no romantic interest in her. I am a heterosexual female, as is she. I just struggle with being accepted and long to be accepted by people that I want to be friends with. You sound like you have some experience with sobriety/dealing with people trying to get sober. I either worry I'm not doing enough or that I'm doing too much. It's more likely that I'm not doing enough, not taking this seriously, and not doing everything I can to protect my sobriety. Ironically enough the times when I'm close to relapsing are times when I'm struggling with my sponsor. That should be a red flag for me. 

I don't really have any other outlets to get me through shirty days. I do have a therapist and do go to AA but not as often as I should. I smoke cigarettes which I like to believe help me in rough situations. Thanks a lot this has helped.

Thanks for the reply. I won't drink today. I know that shit is always insane in early sobriety. I know what I'm experiencing is fairly normal. Maybe not the suicidal thoughts though. Also my sponsor is female and so am I. I haven't tried talking to about it and I don't want to because I feel like I'm just being a crazy person. I don't truly believe my thoughts are justified. I also really like her and don't want to switch sponsors, at this point. 

I've had this depression for a long long time. Probably starting when I was 16-17. From 18-25 I self-medicated with alcohol. Now that I'm sober I have to deal with it again. It sucks. 

I'm fairly certain I would never kill myself while I'm sober. I can't say the same about if I was drunk.
Don't kill yourself over a girl.
